findings.summary: `pnpm typecheck` exits 1 only on 3 errors in src/features/home/OwnerHome.tsx (HomeTrendPoint import, `trend`) and src/features/home/ScoreTrend.tsx, files owned by phase-5-frontend-owner-home (wave 10) after phase-5-backend-home removed `trend` from homeApi. The same 3 errors exist in the baseline before this unit; the four files of this unit add zero type errors.

Capability e2e (tests/e2e/home.spec.ts, settings.spec.ts, companies.spec.ts) and the Play dev-link walkthrough are integration evidence for CAP-ra-home-followup and were not run by this unit (tests belong to other units; owner home is still pending).

The prototype links the consultant indicators to #/empresas?filtro=X; the plan's implementation delta and the backend use `atencao`, so the list reads ?atencao= (atrasada|vencidas|risco|rascunhos|sem-diagnostico). 'Questionários aguardando resposta' is left for phase 6 (no `aguardando` value in CompanyAttention yet).

evidence.result: 3 errors, all in OwnerHome.tsx/ScoreTrend.tsx (not this unit)
same 3 errors in OwnerHome.tsx/ScoreTrend.tsx; 0 errors in ConsultantHome.tsx, CompaniesPage.tsx, ReevaluationSection.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx

evidence.summary: ReevaluationSection: 'Refazer o diagnóstico a cada' select with 60, 90 (recomendado), 120, 180 dias bound to preferences.reevaluationIntervalDays; saves through PreferencesProvider.savePreferences (optimistic, persisted by PUT /api/preferences) with saved/error feedback; shown in SettingsPage under 'Lembrete de reavaliação' (data-aioson-id settings-reevaluation / settings-reevaluation-interval).

ConsultantHome keeps 'Sua carteira' ladder as focus and adds 'O que precisa de você' (data-aioson-id consult-attention) with Reavaliação atrasada, Ações vencidas (sum of overdueActions[].overdueCount, 'em N empresas'), Risco alto, Rascunhos parados; each card links to /empresas?atencao=<value> with data-attention/data-count. 'Sem diagnóstico recente' hint uses reevaluationDays instead of fixed 90; the summary's 'N sem diagnóstico concluído' links to ?atencao=sem-diagnostico. CompaniesPage parses/keeps ?atencao=, sends attention to listCompanies, shows 'Filtro ativo: …' with 'Limpar filtros' (data-aioson-id companies-active-filter), and an empty filtered list shows 'Nenhuma empresa encontrada' + 'Limpar filtros'.
Existing UsageModeSection already switches mode through savePreferences (immediate, persisted); hints updated to the prototype wording.

messages.text: OnboardingTour.tsx consultant step 'Hora de refazer' still says 'mais de 90 dias'; ConsultantHome now uses data.reevaluationDays for the same hint. New tour anchor available: data-aioson-id="consult-attention" ('O que precisa de você'). Existing anchors escada, consult-stalled, consult-old, consult-risk, consult-summary are kept.

After phase-5-frontend-owner-home removes HomeTrendPoint/trend from OwnerHome.tsx and deletes ScoreTrend.tsx, rerun `pnpm typecheck` (expected clean), then `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts`. Selectors: settings select #settings-reevaluation (data-aioson-id settings-reevaluation-interval, option values 60/90/120/180, label '90 dias (recomendado)'); consultant cards [data-aioson-id=consult-attention] a[data-attention=atrasada|vencidas|risco|rascunhos] with data-count; companies list URL /empresas?atencao=<value>, active filter [data-aioson-id=companies-active-filter] with link 'Limpar filtros'.

Prototype uses ?filtro= for the companies list, plan uses ?atencao= (implemented, with ?estagio= kept for stages). If e2e authors follow the prototype, they must use ?atencao=. Phase 6 should add 'aguardando' to CompanyAttention and a card in AttentionWidgets.
